body.objective: Produce the two separate content-addressed executable unary inputs whose absence blocks the certified 160-row replacement-apparatus pushout: the positive-mixed replacement-112 base and the action-derived material-parent-56 complex.
body.stop_condition: Import BERGER_REPLACEMENT_112_POSITIVE_MIXED_ACTION_UNARY, BERGER_DYNAMICAL_APPARATUS_PARENT and BERGER_APPARATUS_160_EXECUTABLE_UNARY_EXPORT_INPUT_SHORTFALL by exact hash.  For each base independently export a canonical coefficient domain, row dictionary, cohomological degrees and parity, normalized sparse q1 and odd-pairing entries, real involution, K_Berger action, support-sector chain groups and zero-mode blocks.  For the material parent also export the detector-smearing chain map; for the replacement base retain every Phi2-dependent positive-mixed Hessian row rather than importing the obsolete 108-row operator.  Verify q1^2=0, cyclicity, pairing rank/nondegeneracy, real/K commutation and every declared support/zero-mode restriction directly from entries.  A method-distinct verifier must reconstruct both matrices from the two action-derived producers and obtain byte-equivalent normal forms.  If either action source is insufficient to derive a coefficient, identify the first missing variational derivative and emit a smaller producer contract instead of filling it by symmetry or row names.
body.current_gate: two executable action-derived unary producer exports
body.forbid: no old 108-row q1 substituted for the changed replacement rows; no action-level rank or zero-defect summary used in place of sparse entries; no combined 160-row quotient before both bases independently pass; no cohomology, q2, q3, Z2, redshift, memory or quantum promotion; no producer reconstruction reused as the independent verifier
activates: resume observer-berger-apparatus-160-executable-unary-export and reconstruct the 160-row pushout from entries
body.resource_hint: OBSERVER PRODUCER REPAIR.  Derive two small executable complexes separately.  Prefer Forge linstruct/cochain as an independent exact replay after the Python action derivation.
notes: This is the typed producer named by the terminal shortfall.  On success the coordinator must resume the blocked 160-row export; success does not itself certify the pushout or its cohomology.
